basis.weather_window: 24 Dec 2026 - 1 Jan 2027. Climatological normals: Hanoi/Ninh Binh 15-23°C days, 12-16°C nights. Ha Giang loop passes (1,000-1,400m) 8-14°C with mountain wind chill.
basis.baggage_allowance: Scoot economy cabin: 2 pieces, max 10kg TOTAL. Checked bag: 20kg shared. Power banks in cabin only.

items.notes: Essential outer barrier against wind chill on the motorbike
Compact down jacket or fleece. Crucial for high altitude passes (Đồng Văn, Mã Pí Lèng)
Breathable technical fabrics
Dedicated base layer for loop riding days
Avoid denim; muddy back-lanes and damp weather
For homestay dinners and temples in Hanoi/Ninh Binh
5-6x moisture-wicking socks. Include 2 thick warm pairs for loop nights
For communal stilt-house homestays
Fits under motorbike helmet to stop freezing wind
Prevents numb hands at 40-50 km/h in 10°C air
For waterfalls or hotel pool
With good grip for 500 stone steps at Hang Mua, Old Quarter pavement, boat wharves. For 500 stone steps at Hang Mua, Old Quarter pavement, boat wharves
For guesthouses, homestay slippers, and relaxing evenings
Prevents blisters during walking days
Main camera, Grab ride-hailing, maps, and offline tickets
High-capacity power banks. Must carry in cabin baggage only per airline rules
Vietnam uses 220V Euro 2-pin round plugs (Type C/F)
For nighttime walks in traditional stilt-house homestays
For Hanoi night sleeper bus and long minivan transits

items.item: Vietnam eSIM or local SIM card
items.notes: Viettel recommended for strongest 4G mountain coverage
Must have 6+ months validity upon entry. Singapore passport holders enter visa-free for up to 30 days
Essential for filling arrival / customs declaration cards on planes and at immigration
Return flight tickets & accommodation vouchers. Keep printed paper copy + offline PDF on phone
Ensure coverage includes pillion passenger on motorbike
Registered before departure at eregister.mfa.gov.sg
Stored separately from original passport in daypack
Small denominations for Ha Giang markets, street food, tips
Winter sun at 1,400m altitude plus wind burns quickly
Dengue protection in Ninh Binh wetlands and valleys
Compact toiletry kit
Homestays on the loop may not supply large towels
Pocket tissues, wet wipes & hand sanitizer. Public restrooms in rural areas rarely have toilet paper
Essential for sleeper bus and shared stilt-house rooms
Travel shampoo / soap / body wash (<100ml). Meets Scoot cabin liquid limits
Must-have for Mã Pí Lèng winding cliffs and night sleeper bus
Pain relief, fever, and muscle soreness from riding
Loperamide (Imodium) & activated charcoal. Anti-diarrhoeal medication for street food adjustments
ORS electrolyte sachets for rapid hydration. Rapid hydration after long active travel days
Antiseptic cream & assorted band-aids for cuts, scrapes, and blisters. Cuts, scrapes, and blister plasters for walking shoes
Personal prescription medication + doctor's memo. Packed in cabin bag in original pharmacy boxes
